stick.trigger.name: Trigger
stick.trigger.note: red two-stage trigger at the front

stick.gimbal.name: Stick (roll / pitch)
stick.gimbal.note: grip foot on the base mount, the grip moves the base's roll and pitch

unplaced.stick.hat.trim: cross-shaped switch on the thumb face; which hat is the trim hat is not documented
unplaced.stick.button.thumb.1: red button on the thumb face; which button is "thumb 1" is not documented
unplaced.stick.button.thumb.2: which button is "thumb 2" is not documented

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), three-quarter view from behind on the left: thumb face (red button, POV hat, cross switch, REV button, side wheel), TGL button on the right, trigger, base mount
mappingSource: catalog (us.mozaracing.com/products/mhg-flightstick, "Numbering unpublished."): the parts carry no button numbers. Retailer listings (e.g. simufy.com/en/products/moza-flightstick-mhg) describe 4 buttons, three 5-way switches, one 3-way switch, a Hall hat (axis or buttons), a two-stage trigger and a lockable Z twist; no public manual names a trim hat or numbers the thumb buttons.
note: Only the trigger (two-stage, the only trigger) and the gimbal are certain. Which hat is the catalog's "trim hat" and which buttons are "thumb 1/2" is not documented, so those stay hidden candidates. The grip has many more controls than the catalog lists (POV Hall hat, 5-way switches, 3-way switch, side wheel, TGL, REV, DEF lever, twist axis).
